verdict: partly consistent: 82 signs = 82 letters of the corrected verse, 22 groups = 22 words; one letter per shape except S8 (H) = ق in قد and ن in فان, and S12 (U) = ل five times and ن once (نسيت); ا has three shapes (S3, S1, S17), ح two (S15, S19)
notes: Rows: 8r l.11-13, 8v l.1-4 (8v l.4 = 6 signs, a cipher row as the record says). Measured 13+14+12+12+13+12+6 = 82 signs (record 88) and 22 dividers (record 19). Record errors: (1) the first word is انادم (أنادمٌ, 'are you regretful'), 5 signs S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 = ا ن ا د م, not 'ا ادم' (errata) or 'يا ادم'; (2) the cipher has 'ام ناسي' at the end of the first hemistich (groups S17 S5 = ام, S2 S3 S16 S18 = ناسي): the interlinear 'ام ناسي' over 8v l.7 is part of the verse (rhyme -nāsī with الناس), not a variant; the verse then reads أنادم أنت عما قد وعدت به من التفضل والإحسان أم ناسي / فإن ندمت فحكم المجد يمنعه وإن نسيت فكم ناسٍ من الناس. With these two changes signs, letters, groups and words all match (82/82, 22/22). Exceptions kept as the cipher has them: S8 H stands for ق (قد) and for ن (فان), shapes checked at 2x and not told apart; نسيت opens with S12 U (elsewhere ل) instead of S2 (ن); S17 (comb on a V) for the ا of ام occurs once. S1 (tailed horned triangle) may be a careless S3; kept apart. S10 ⊐ (ب) and S18 ⊏ (ي) are mirror brackets.
